# IPC mapping to Tauri and Rust

<!-- Generated by tools/tauri-migration/ipc-mapping.mjs from ipc-mapping.json. Do not edit. -->

Reference: commit ef401b20cb2a5960278a8e7ab2c0e96d8f759aeb.

Proposed mapping from every reference IPC namespace record to a Tauri/Rust boundary. It records design intent only. Nothing here is implemented except where state is diagnostic-partial, and no entry is verified on any platform.

Every namespace record of the [IPC inventory](ipc-inventory.json) has exactly one row below, and the test in tools/tauri-migration/ipc-mapping.test.mjs fails if a record, a method or a parity item is left without a destination. Rows with groups list the methods of each group so that no method is implied by its namespace.

## Caller classes

- app-window: Windows created by Rust from the trusted bundle, on the local origin only
- popup-window: Rust-created popup windows with their own minimal capability set

## Design notes

### main:command:auth

- Replaces: Electron main-process token broker, browser sign-in handoff and session persistence
- Design: Rust owns refresh-token storage, serialized refresh and access-token minting. Sign-in opens the system browser through a vetted URL policy and completes through the deep-link handoff. Responses carry no refresh token; getValidAccessToken returns only a short-lived access token to an app window that asked for it.
- Constraint: Persist in the OS keychain with the reference memory-only fallback; never in WebView storage
- Constraint: Endpoint origin normalization and no credential attachment to redirects or arbitrary URLs
- Blocked by: Authorized cloud test endpoint is not available, so only transport and unit behavior can be tested until one is provided
- Methods (7): clearSession, getValidAccessToken, signInMagicLink, signInOauth, signInOpenAppSignInCode, signInPassword, signOut

### main:command:byokStorage

- Replaces: Electron safeStorage-backed workspace BYOK key store
- Design: Rust encrypts provider credentials at rest with an OS-keychain-held key, enforces workspace isolation and ordering, and exposes metadata operations. isSupported reports real keychain availability; no stub success.
- Constraint: Raw secrets never travel in events and are returned only where the reference returns them
- Constraint: Copying Electron safeStorage ciphertext is not an interoperable migration; import needs an explicit user-driven re-entry or a documented decryption path per OS
- Methods (7): clearWorkspaceKeys, deleteWorkspaceKey, getWorkspaceLeaseProviders, isSupported, listWorkspaceKeys, reorderWorkspaceKeys, upsertWorkspaceKey

### main:command:clipboard

- Replaces: Electron clipboard.writeImage for PNG
- Design: PNG bytes arrive as a raw IPC body bounded by a documented limit and are written through the Tauri clipboard facility or a vetted OS adapter. Round-trip format fidelity is a gate.
- Constraint: Verify the written clipboard format per OS by reading it back with a native tool
- Methods (1): copyAsPNG

### main:command:configStorage

- Replaces: Electron config.json store
- Design: Revisioned Rust store with atomic writes; hydrated before the frontend module graph is imported so the reference synchronous reads stay valid.
- Constraint: Schema validation on set; unknown keys rejected rather than silently stored
- Methods (2): get, set

### main:command:debug

- Replaces: Electron log path and reveal-in-folder
- Design: Rust owns the log directory; reveal uses the OS file-manager integration with a path the host computed, never a renderer path.
- Methods (2): logFilePath, revealLogFile

### main:command:i18n

- Replaces: Electron application-menu relocalization
- Design: Persists the language and rebuilds native menu and tray labels from it.
- Methods (1): changeLanguage

### main:command:import

- Replaces: Electron import sessions in the main process
- Design: Sessions are Rust-owned, tied to the creating window, bounded in count and bytes, and disposed with the window. Batches stream over a Tauri channel or raw IPC body with cancellation that accounts for accepted work.
- Constraint: Paths come only from native dialogs or Tauri drag-drop events and become opaque grants; no renderer-supplied path is trusted
- Methods (4): cancelImportSession, createImportSession, disposeImportSession, nextImportBatch

### preload:command:import

- Replaces: Electron preload translation of browser File selections to native paths
- Design: Tauri has no File.path. Native selection or Tauri drag-drop events yield grants consumed by createImportSession; the frontend adapter keeps the same call shape for shared UI code.
- Constraint: Browser-only File objects without a grant must be imported through the existing web path, not through a native path guess
- Methods (1): createImportSessionFromSource

### main:command:findInPage

- Replaces: Electron webContents.findInPage
- Design: Tauri 2 has no stable find-in-page API. Candidates: WebKitGTK FindController, WebView2 find APIs where exposed, WKWebView find. A per-platform spike must show match counts and navigation before this is accepted.
- Open risk: No cross-platform stable API; if a platform cannot match semantics the difference must be documented as a legitimate platform difference, not omitted
- Methods (2): clear, find

### main:command:popup

- Replaces: Electron popup windows for notifications and recording
- Design: Rust creates popup WebViews with their own minimal capability set; commands are granted to the popup label only.
- Methods (3): dismissCurrentNotification, dismissCurrentRecording, getCurrentNotification

### main:command:recording

- Replaces: Electron recording coordinator over native media_capture
- Design: Port the coordinator state machine to Rust over the existing media-capture crate without N-API. Permission flows are OS specific. Linux is unavailable as in the reference.
- Constraint: Real capture on Windows and macOS only; mocks do not satisfy P24
- Group lifecycle (9): setupRecordingFeature, disableRecordingFeature, checkRecordingAvailable, startRecording, stopRecording, getCurrentRecording, getRecording, removeRecording, dismissRecordingStatus
- Group permissions (3): askForMeetingPermission, checkMeetingPermissions, showRecordingPermissionSetting
- Group files (2): readRecordingFile, showSavedRecordings
- Group importQueue (4): claimRecordingImport, completeRecordingImport, failRecordingImport, getRecordingImportQueue

### main:command:sharedStorage

- Replaces: Electron shared global state and cache with synchronous preload reads
- Design: Rust holds revisioned state. The page is hydrated before the application imports, then updates flow through events carrying revision and source ID so echoes are suppressed and cross-view order is preserved.
- Methods (8): clearGlobalCache, clearGlobalState, delGlobalCache, delGlobalState, getAllGlobalCache, getAllGlobalState, setGlobalCache, setGlobalState

### main:command:ui

- Replaces: Electron window, tab and view manager
- Design: Rust owns windows, tabs and workbench metadata. Native decorations stay hidden from construction, so the minimize, maximize and close actions below are driven by the application controls.
- Constraint: openExternal accepts only validated schemes and never receives native capabilities in the opened content
- Constraint: captureArea needs a per-OS WebView capture adapter with exact-area tests
- Constraint: getChallengeResponse reuses the existing hashcash implementation without N-API
- Constraint: showDevTools is a debug-only capability
- Group windowControls (8): handleCloseApp, handleHideApp, handleMaximizeApp, handleMinimizeApp, handleOpenMainApp, handleWindowResize, isFullScreen, isMaximized
- Group tabs (15): activateView, addTab, closeTab, ensureTabLoaded, getTabsStatus, getTabViewsMeta, getWorkbenchMeta, isActiveTab, moveTab, showTab, showTabContextMenu, tabGoTo, updateActiveViewMeta, updateWorkbenchMeta, updateWorkbenchViewMeta
- Group appearance (4): handleThemeChange, onLanguageChange, openThemeEditor, toggleRightSidebar
- Group lifecycle (2): pingAppLayoutReady, restartApp
- Group platformServices (4): captureArea, getChallengeResponse, openExternal, showDevTools

### main:command:updater

- Replaces: Electron auto-updater
- Design: Tauri updater with a signed feed for fork artifacts. Progress flows over a channel and restart-install preserves local data.
- Blocked by: Signing keys and a controlled update feed are not available
- Methods (6): checkForUpdates, currentVersion, downloadUpdate, getConfig, quitAndInstall, setConfig

### main:command:worker

- Replaces: Electron MessagePort broker for shared and background workers
- Design: Decision recorded in worker-transport-decision.md: dedicated Workers with a private port to a trusted main-thread bridge session; SharedWorker is not relied on because Linux and macOS WebViews give it an opaque origin that cannot use IndexedDB.
- Open risk: P21 asks to share workers across tabs. Cross-tab sharing of background work must be provided by Rust-owned sessions or a documented difference; it is not yet designed
- Methods (2): connectWorker, disconnectWorker

### helper:command:db

- Replaces: Electron helper SQLite v1 reader
- Design: Read-only Rust reader of legacy v1 files used by the migration; backups are taken before any conversion and the originals are never modified.
- Constraint: Back up WAL-backed databases consistently, not by copying storage.db alone
- Methods (4): getBlob, getBlobKeys, getDocAsUpdates, getDocTimestamps

### helper:event:db

- Replaces: No exported members at the reference revision
- Design: Nothing to implement; the record is kept so the empty registry is explicit.

### helper:command:dialog

- Replaces: Electron native dialogs for database files and the sync folder
- Design: Dialogs are opened by Rust through the Tauri dialog facility, return opaque grants and keep system-owned presentation.
- Methods (3): loadDBFile, saveDBFileAs, selectMarkdownSyncFolder

### helper:command:diskSync

- Replaces: Electron helper folder synchronization
- Design: Reuse the existing disk_sync engine without N-API. Sessions are owned by the starting window; events stream over a channel and stop with the session.
- Constraint: Traversal, symlink and race tests plus real file round trips
- Methods (5): acknowledgeSourceUpdate, applyLocalUpdate, prepareSourceDoc, startSession, stopSession

### helper:event:diskSync

- Replaces: Electron onEvent helper notification
- Design: Session-scoped channel with a bounded queue and an explicit resync signal when the consumer lags.
- Methods (1): onEvent

### helper:command:nbstore

- Replaces: Electron helper nbstore over N-API
- Design: StorageSession owns one host-granted space, with the dedicated-Worker bridge in front. The diagnostic exercises getDoc and pushUpdate only; the rest is not implemented.
- Constraint: Raw binary bodies with a ticket header; bounds enforced in the core independently of the bridge
- Constraint: Snapshot and revision event transport are not designed in code yet
- Group lifecycle (2): connect, disconnect
- Group documents (5): getDoc, pushUpdate, deleteDoc, getDocClock, getDocClocks
- Group blobs (7): getBlob, setBlob, deleteBlob, listBlobs, releaseBlobs, getBlobUploadedAt, setBlobUploadedAt
- Group syncClocks (10): clearClocks, getPeerPulledRemoteClock, getPeerPulledRemoteClocks, getPeerPushedClock, getPeerPushedClocks, getPeerRemoteClock, getPeerRemoteClocks, setPeerPulledRemoteClock, setPeerPushedClock, setPeerRemoteClock
- Group indexer (12): clearDocIndexedClock, crawlDocData, getDocIndexedClock, indexAggregate, indexDelete, indexDeleteByQuery, indexFlush, indexSearch, indexUpsert, indexVersion, setDocIndexedClock, setDocIndexedClocks

### helper:command:preview

- Replaces: Electron helper Mermaid and Typst rendering
- Design: Reuse affine_preview without N-API on a bounded blocking pool; input size and render time are limited and invalid input returns an explicit error.
- Methods (2): renderMermaidSvg, renderTypstSvg

### helper:command:workspace

- Replaces: Electron helper workspace enumeration, trash and backup recovery
- Design: Rust owns the sessionData layout and performs moves with backup-first semantics; identifiers are validated, never joined into paths as given.
- Methods (6): delete, deleteBackupWorkspace, getBackupWorkspaces, listLocalWorkspaceIds, moveToTrash, recoverBackupWorkspace

### helper:event:workspace

- Replaces: No exported members at the reference revision
- Design: Nothing to implement; the record is kept so the empty registry is explicit.

### main:event:applicationMenu

- Replaces: Electron application menu actions
- Design: Native Tauri menu items emit targeted events to the focused app window; accelerators are verified per OS.
- Methods (3): onNewPageAction, onOpenJournal, openInSettingModal

### main:event:popup

- Replaces: Electron popup notification change event
- Design: Targeted event to the popup label only.
- Methods (1): onNotificationChanged

### main:event:power

- Replaces: Electron powerMonitor source change
- Design: No stable Tauri API: needs per-OS adapters (Linux logind or UPower, Windows power broadcast, macOS IOKit) with an initial state read.
- Open risk: Adapter choice per OS is unproven
- Methods (1): power-source

### main:event:recording

- Replaces: Electron recording status and import queue notifications
- Design: Revisioned events, registered before the first snapshot.
- Methods (2): onRecordingImportQueueChanged, onRecordingStatusChanged

### main:event:sharedStorage

- Replaces: Electron shared state change notifications
- Design: Revision and source ID on every event; terminal lag forces a resnapshot.
- Methods (2): onGlobalCacheChanged, onGlobalStateChanged

### main:event:ui

- Replaces: Electron window and tab notifications
- Design: Targeted per-window events; tab events carry revisions so reorder and close races are detected.
- Group windowState (2): onFullScreen, onMaximized
- Group tabs (7): onActiveTabChanged, onCloseView, onTabAction, onTabGoToRequest, onTabShellViewActiveChange, onTabsStatusChange, onTabViewsMetaChanged
- Group appearance (1): onToggleRightSidebar
- Group authentication (1): onAuthenticationRequest

### main:event:updater

- Replaces: Electron updater events
- Design: Channel events for availability, progress and readiness.
- Blocked by: Signing keys and a controlled update feed are not available
- Methods (3): onDownloadProgress, onUpdateAvailable, onUpdateReady

## Parity surfaces outside the IPC inventory

| Parity | Surface                                                                         | Route               | Evidence so far                                                             |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P01    | Editor and blocks run in the existing shared frontend inside the native WebView | frontend-reuse      | Native WebView smoke on three platforms covers creation and text input only |
| P02    | Edgeless canvas in the shared frontend                                          | frontend-reuse      | Native WebView smoke switches to edgeless only                              |
| P03    | Workspaces, documents, search and navigation in the shared frontend             | frontend-reuse      | Needs full E2E on Tauri                                                     |
| P12    | Tab strip visuals and drag behavior                                             | frontend-adapter    | Routing feasibility only; see workbench-design.md                           |
| P14    | Tray or menu-bar item and close-to-tray                                         | rust-native-ui      | None yet                                                                    |
| P16    | Deep links and single instance                                                  | rust-native-service | None yet                                                                    |
| P26    | Embedded assets, custom protocol, CSP, URL policy and API proxy                 | rust-native-service | Enforced CSP with embedded frontend passes on three platforms               |
| P28    | Installers, signing and CI architecture matrix                                  | tauri-bundler       | None yet; signing credentials are not available                             |
